stem.text: Two positive charges and one negative charge, all of equal magnitude, are set at the corners of an equilateral triangle.
Which diagram best represents the electric field surrounding the charges?

A.alt: Field-line diagram with arrowed curved lines around circles labelled − (one) and + (two) arranged at the corners of a triangle.

B.alt: Field-line diagram with arrowed straight and curved lines around circles labelled − (one) and + (two) arranged at the corners of a triangle.

C.alt: Field-line diagram with closed curved lines around a circle labelled − and two circles labelled +, placed side by side.

D.alt: Field-line diagram with closed curved lines around circles labelled − (one) and + (two) arranged at the corners of a triangle.
